variables.section_text: Item 1.01. Entry into a Material Definitive Agreement. On August 2, 2026, Solstice Software, Inc. entered into an Agreement and Plan of Merger with Continental Holdings, Inc., pursuant to which Continental will acquire all outstanding shares of the Company's common stock for $94.00 per share in cash. The purchase price represents a premium of approximately 41% to the closing price of the Company's common stock on July 31, 2026. The transaction is expected to close in the fourth quarter of 2026, subject to shareholder and regulatory approvals.

variables.section_text: Item 2.06. Material Impairments. On October 20, 2026, management concluded that the carrying value of goodwill associated with the Company's Personal Care reporting unit exceeded its fair value, and that a non-cash impairment charge of approximately $1.15 billion will be recorded in the third quarter of fiscal 2026. The impairment reflects sustained volume declines, loss of distribution at two major retail customers, and a higher discount rate.

variables.section_text: Item 8.01. Other Events. On January 29, 2026, the Board of Directors authorized a new share repurchase program permitting the repurchase of up to $2.0 billion of the Company's outstanding common stock, representing approximately 11% of shares outstanding based on the closing price on January 28, 2026. The program has no expiration date and replaces the prior authorization, under which approximately $140 million remained available.

Item 3.01. Notice of Delisting or Failure to Satisfy a Continued Listing Rule. On September 9, 2026, the Company received a deficiency letter from the Listing Qualifications Department of The Nasdaq Stock Market notifying the Company that, for the preceding 30 consecutive business days, the closing bid price for the Company's common stock was below the minimum $1.00 per share requirement for continued listing under Nasdaq Listing Rule 5450(a)(1). The Company has 180 calendar days to regain compliance.
